4. Antidromic AV reentrant tachycardia (pre‑excited tachycardia/WPW) producing a wide complex very rapid rhythm
5. Drug‑ or metabolic‑induced wide‑complex tachycardia (eg, proarrhythmia from antiarrhythmics such as class I agents or severe electrolyte abnormalities)
